title: Authorship Cluster for Keqing: Knowledge-Based Question Answering as a Chain-of-Thought Mentor
summary: This community consists of the eight authors of the 2023 paper 'keqing: knowledge-based question answering is a nature chain-of-thought mentor of LLM'. The cluster is defined entirely by the 'AUTHORED_BY' relationships linking each individual to the specific publication. The paper, identified by arXiv ID 2401.00426, focuses on leveraging knowledge-based question answering to enhance Large Language Models (LLMs) through chain-of-thought mechanisms.
key_findings: The paper 'keqing' was authored by a team of eight researchers: Bo An, Bo Chen, Chaojie Wang, Chenxi Zhang, Lei Feng, Xinrun Wang, Yishi Xu, and Zhong Peng.
Chaojie Wang is listed as the first author of the paper, followed by Yishi Xu, Zhong Peng, Chenxi Zhang, Bo Chen, Xinrun Wang, Lei Feng, and Bo An.
The publication is categorized under the field of Computation and Language (cs.CL) on arXiv.
The paper proposes that knowledge-based question answering serves as a 'nature chain-of-thought mentor' for Large Language Models.
All internal relationships within this community are direct authorship links to the single central paper entity.
The paper was published in 2023, as indicated by the citation metadata provided in the source passages.
